results.q: I'm having trouble using the App What should I do?
results.a:
If you have any issues using the App click on the "Support" link on the sidebar of the App.

This will generate a WhatsApp message to our team and we will do our best to help you as soon as possible. You can also reach out to your local Circles Field Officer

results.q: How does the Circles Helpline work?
results.a: You can find the support button on the side bar menu on all pages on the application. Click on it and you will automatically be redirected to WhatsApp to chat with the Circles team

results.q: I sent a message to the helpline but haven't had a response, what should I do?
results.a: Please reach out to your local Circles Representative (Field Officer)

results.q: Can I call someone for help?
results.a: You can call your local Circles Representative (Field Officer)
